matching_policy: Exact case-sensitive code match restricted to existing corpus; no aliases, suffix stripping, or related matches.
label_policy: Source description with leading/trailing whitespace removed only; source wording not independently scientifically validated. Existing loader calls all explicit labels curated.
category_policy: Restore the original 11 categories from preserved_entries at user request on 2026-10-07. The 769 added entries have no inferred category; the existing loader defaults missing categories to other. Customer group/dichotomous remain independent source attributes in provenance.
